premise: The forest wakes one sound at a time inside a white mist until the sun lifts it off like a blanket.
inspiration: Cumulative dawn litany (The House That Jack Built): each new sound joins the ones before, and the turn is light itself arriving.
lesson: Every small voice is part of the morning.

en-US.title: Good Morning, Forest
en-US.text: {bee:float loop 0.4} {all:face sleeping} {canvas:fog 0.6 18s} [softly] Early in the morning, the forest is wrapped in a white, woolly mist. Nothing sings. Then… {sfx:drip} drip. A dewdrop falls from a leaf. Drip, drop. In the grass, a little {flower:enter} flower pops up… but she is still sleepy, and {flower:live hold} folds her petals up tight like a bud. A {bird:enter} bird flies down to a branch and {bird:face happy} wakes up. He {bird:live} puffs out his chest, tips back his head and sings. Tweet-tweet-tweeee! Along buzzes a {bee:enter} {bee:face happy} bee, zigzagging through the mist. She {bee:live} takes a deep breath, hums a happy tune and wiggles a little dance. [whispers] Is it morning yet? asks the sleepy flower. [excited] Here comes the answer: {canvas:sunshine 0.9 14s} the sun {all:glow} peeks over the hills and lifts the mist away, like a blanket off a bed. The flower {flower:live resume} opens her petals wide and smiles. {sfx:birdsong} {bird:hop} Tweet, {bee:shake} bzzz, drip, drop… {all:face happy} {all:hop} [happily] Good morning, forest!

es-ES.title: Buenos días, bosque
es-ES.text: {bee:float loop 0.4} {all:face sleeping} {canvas:fog 0.6 18s} [softly] Muy temprano, el bosque está envuelto en una niebla blanca y esponjosa. Nada canta. Y entonces… {sfx:drip} plic. Una gota de rocío cae de una hoja. Plic, ploc. Entre la hierba asoma una {flower:enter} florecilla… pero todavía tiene sueño, y {flower:live hold} cierra sus pétalos como un capullo. Un {bird:enter} pajarito baja volando a una rama y {bird:face happy} se despierta. {bird:live} Hincha el pecho, echa la cabeza atrás y canta. ¡Pío-pío-píooo! Llega una {bee:enter} {bee:face happy} abeja, zigzagueando entre la niebla. {bee:live} Respira hondo, tararea una canción alegre y se marca un bailecito. [whispers] ¿Ya es de día?, pregunta la flor dormida. [excited] Y llega la respuesta: {canvas:sunshine 0.9 14s} el sol {all:glow} asoma por las colinas y se lleva la niebla, como quien quita una manta de la cama. La flor {flower:live resume} abre sus pétalos de par en par y sonríe. {sfx:birdsong} {bird:hop} Pío, {bee:shake} bzzz, plic, ploc… {all:face happy} {all:hop} [happily] ¡Buenos días, bosque!

drip.prompt: a single clear water droplet falling from a leaf into a tiny puddle, soft plip

birdsong.prompt: a small songbird's cheerful morning chirps with a soft bee buzz nearby
